title: Copper Tundra: The Historian's Aurora Register
premise: In a magnetized polar steppe threaded by buried power rails, the historian must recover lost testimony without rewriting it using a chronicle decoding slate.
ending: Recover the Aurora Register and return with the unaltered historical account; Polar Surveyors can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive conductive frost while evading the rail colossus without sacrificing the unaltered historical account.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Polar Surveyors to witness the chronicle decoding slate.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal a compromising record
